payment_attempts_provider_fields.name: payment_attempts_provider_fields
payment_attempts_provider_fields.value: (provider_prebook_ref IS NULL) = (provider_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (mode = 'PROVIDER_MANAGED' OR (provider_prebook_ref IS NULL AND provider_client_secret IS NULL AND pay_by IS NULL))

pricing_policy_versions_approval_mode.name: pricing_policy_versions_approval_mode
pricing_policy_versions_approval_mode.value: (approved_by IS NULL) = (approval_mode IS NULL) AND (approval_mode IS NULL OR approval_mode IN ('FOUR_EYES', 'SELF')) AND (approval_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'FOUR_EYES' OR (approved_by <> created_by AND approved_by <> updated_by))

provider_bookings_commission_pair.name: provider_bookings_commission_pair
provider_bookings_commission_pair.value: (provider_commission_minor IS NULL) = (provider_commission_currency IS NULL) AND (provider_commission_minor IS NULL OR provider_commission_minor >= 0)

provider_commissions_received_has_payout.name: provider_commissions_received_has_payout
provider_commissions_received_has_payout.value: status <> 'RECEIVED' OR payout_reference IS NOT NULL

risk_policy_versions_approval_mode.name: risk_policy_versions_approval_mode
risk_policy_versions_approval_mode.value: (approved_by IS NULL) = (approval_mode IS NULL) AND (approval_mode IS NULL OR approval_mode IN ('FOUR_EYES', 'SELF')) AND (approval_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'FOUR_EYES' OR (approved_by <> created_by AND approved_by <> updated_by))

staff_users_email_normalized.name: staff_users_email_normalized
staff_users_email_normalized.value: email = lower(btrim(email)) AND position('@' in email) > 1

staff_users_active_has_password.name: staff_users_active_has_password
staff_users_active_has_password.value: status <> 'ACTIVE' OR password_hash IS NOT NULL
